import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 10))
    .cylinder(20.0, 3.0)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 20))
            .sphere(3.2)
    )
    .cut(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 16.8))
            .box(50, 50, 5)
    )
)
show_object(result)
